VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence confirms criterion (2) — all 72 tests pass — but provides nothing to verify criterion (1), that the token-refresh race condition was actually fixed. A passing test suite only proves the bug is fixed if there is a test that specifically reproduces the race condition and now passes. No such test (e.g., a concurrent-refresh test, or a diff/before-after showing the previously failing case) is shown, and the self-report's "all tests pass" doesn't distinguish between "the race-condition bug is gone" and "no test ever exercised the race." Race conditions are also notoriously hard to catch with standard tests, so green CI is weak evidence here. Without a code diff or a targeted regression test demonstrating the race is resolved, criterion (1) is unverified.
